stories.stat_label: years since the Romans made it
stories.headline: A technician recreated the Lycurgus Cup's magic glass
stories.summary: The 4th-century Roman cup looks jade green in reflected light and ruby red with light behind it. After many experiments, Dr Lisa Hollands made glass that does the same, in quantity.
stories.why: Nobody knew exactly how the Romans did it. A new sculpture made from her glass goes on show in November.

stories.stat_label: object ever seen from another star
stories.headline: Webb found ice from another star system like our own
stories.summary: Watching interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS 3 times, the James Webb telescope saw tiny grains of dusty water ice. They match icy worlds beyond Neptune.
stories.why: Planets around other stars may be built from the same kind of icy bits as ours.

stories.stat_label: of bonobo hunts led by females
stories.headline: Female bonobos turn out to be the main hunters
stories.summary: A 10-year study of 2 wild groups found females led 60% of hunts with known hunters, even mothers carrying babies. Older females caught forest antelopes 3 times as often as males.
stories.why: It challenges the old 'man the hunter' story of how our ancestors lived.

stories.headline: A stranger's wrong turn saved a big foster family
stories.summary: His GPS sent Casey down an unfamiliar road, where he saw a house on fire. He ran in, woke the dad and helped get 11 children and a grandchild out safely.
stories.why: The Burkes have cared for 500 children over the years, and now their community is rallying for them.

fun_fact: The Lycurgus Cup is the only Roman glass cage cup known to change colour like this.
